ST-503 drew no winning bid at the 2026-08-10 auction: its platforms and ST-506 went to Lilly (closed 2026-09-04, 8-K 0001104659-26-105905) and ST-920 to PTC Therapeutics (closed 2026-09-17, 8-K 0001193125-26-396644), while 'Sangamo continues to solicit and review offers for its other key assets including the clinical-stage programs ST-503 for chronic neuropathic pain' (press release of 2026-08-13, 8-K 0001193125-26-347524, Ex. 99.1). The common stock was delisted from Nasdaq effective 2026-10-17 and trades on the OTC Expert Market (8-K 0001193125-26-434171); the September monthly operating report shows 13 full-time employees against 74 at the petition date (same filing, Ex. 99.3)
